title: Procedural Marble Material with Vein Generation
prompt:
Create a single HTML file with Three.js (via CDN) that implements a procedural marble material with interactive vein generation on a 3D object. Requirements:

## Scene Setup
- Create a scene with a dark gray background (#1a1a1a)
- Add a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 0, 4) looking at origin
- Add OrbitControls for camera manipulation
- Add three lights: one DirectionalLight (white, intensity 1.5) at (5,5,5), one AmbientLight (white, intensity 0.3), and one PointLight (warm white #ffe0b0, intensity 0.8) at (-3, 2, -2)
- Display a sphere (radius 1.5, 128x128 segments) at the origin with the procedural marble shader

## Procedural Marble Shader
- Implement a custom ShaderMaterial with vertex and fragment shaders
- The marble effect uses layered Perlin/simplex noise to create veins
- Expose these uniform parameters:
  - u_baseColor: vec3 (default white: 0.95, 0.93, 0.90)
  - u_veinColor: vec3 (default dark gray: 0.15, 0.12, 0.10)
  - u_veinFrequency: float (default 3.0, range 0.5-12.0) - controls vein density
  - u_veinSharpness: float (default 4.0, range 1.0-20.0) - controls vein edge sharpness
  - u_veinAmplitude: float (default 0.8, range 0.0-2.0) - controls vein prominence
  - u_noiseOctaves: int (default 4, range 1-8) - noise detail layers
  - u_turbulence: float (default 1.0, range 0.0-3.0) - vein distortion amount
  - u_seed: float (default 42.0) - random seed for pattern variation
  - u_secondaryVeinEnabled: bool (default true) - enables secondary thin veins
  - u_secondaryVeinScale: float (default 8.0, range 2.0-20.0)
  - u_polishLevel: float (default 0.7, range 0.0-1.0) - surface reflectivity/glossiness

## Geometry Options
- Support switching between geometries: sphere (default), cube (BoxGeometry 2.5x2.5x2.5), torus (radius 1.2, tube 0.5), and plane (3x3)
- Pressing keys 1-4 switches geometry (1=sphere, 2=cube, 3=torus, 4=plane)

## UI Controls (DOM)
- Create a control panel (position: fixed, top-right, 300px wide, semi-transparent dark background)
- Add labeled range sliders for: veinFrequency, veinSharpness, veinAmplitude, turbulence, noiseOctaves, secondaryVeinScale, polishLevel
- Add a color picker for baseColor (id='baseColorPicker') and veinColor (id='veinColorPicker')
- Add a checkbox (id='secondaryVeinToggle') for secondary vein enable/disable
- Add a 'Randomize Seed' button (id='randomizeSeedBtn') that generates a new random seed
- Add an 'Export Preset' button (id='exportPresetBtn') that saves current settings to a preset
- Add an 'Undo' button (id='undoBtn') and 'Redo' button (id='redoBtn') for parameter changes

## Undo/Redo System
- Maintain a history stack of parameter states (max 50 entries)
- Every slider change, color change, toggle, or seed randomization pushes to history
- Undo reverts to previous state, Redo re-applies forward state
- Track historyIndex and historyStack length

## State Management
- Expose window.__3D_STATE__ with:
  - veinFrequency: current float value
  - veinSharpness: current float value
  - veinAmplitude: current float value
  - turbulence: current float value
  - noiseOctaves: current int value
  - secondaryVeinEnabled: boolean
  - secondaryVeinScale: current float value
  - polishLevel: current float value
  - baseColor: {r, g, b} normalized 0-1
  - veinColor: {r, g, b} normalized 0-1
  - seed: current seed value
  - currentGeometry: string ('sphere'|'cube'|'torus'|'plane')
  - historyIndex: int (current position in undo stack)
  - historyLength: int (total entries in history)
  - presetExported: boolean (true after export clicked)
  - lastPreset: object with all parameter values at export time
  - frameCount: int incrementing each render
  - meshVertexCount: int (vertex count of current geometry)
  - materialType: 'ShaderMaterial'
  - uniformsValid: boolean (true if all uniforms are non-NaN and within range)

## Animation
- No automatic animation of parameters (static marble)
- OrbitControls allow rotation
- Render loop updates frameCount

## Validation
- All uniform values must remain within their defined ranges at all times
- uniformsValid must check: no NaN values, all floats within min/max bounds
- Geometry switch must preserve all material parameters
physics_constraints: All shader uniform values must remain within defined bounds (veinFrequency: 0.5-12.0, veinSharpness: 1.0-20.0, veinAmplitude: 0.0-2.0, turbulence: 0.0-3.0, noiseOctaves: 1-8, secondaryVeinScale: 2.0-20.0, polishLevel: 0.0-1.0). Color components must be in [0,1]. No NaN values permitted in any uniform. Undo/redo must perfectly restore previous states with zero drift.
